privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introText: Financentury ("we", "our", "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your information when you use our budget management platform.
privacy.collectAccountText: When you create an account, we collect your email address, name, and profile picture through Google OAuth or email registration. This information is necessary to provide you with a personalized experience.
privacy.collectFinancialText: You may enter budget amounts, income figures, expense records, and financial goals. This data is stored solely to provide the budgeting service and is never sold or shared with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy.collectUsageText: We collect basic usage data such as login timestamps and feature interactions to improve the platform. We do not use third-party analytics trackers.
privacy.useText1: Provide and maintain the budgeting service
privacy.useText2: Authenticate your identity and secure your account
privacy.useText3: Enable collaboration features with other users you invite
privacy.useText4: Improve the platform based on aggregated, anonymized usage patterns
privacy.storageText: Your data is stored in secure PostgreSQL databases hosted on Google Cloud Platform. All data in transit is encrypted via TLS. Passwords are hashed using bcrypt. We do not store raw passwords.
privacy.sharingText: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal or financial data with third parties. The only exception is when you explicitly invite a collaborator to your budget — they will see the budget data you share with them.
privacy.retentionText: Expense records older than 12 months are automatically deleted. You can delete your account and all associated data at any time from your account settings.
privacy.rightsText: You have the right to access, update, or delete your personal data at any time. To delete your account and all data, go to Account Settings and select "Delete Account".
privacy.cookiesText: We use a JSON Web Token (JWT) stored in your browser's local storage for authentication. We do not use tracking cookies or third-party cookies.
privacy.changesText: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected on this page with an updated revision date.
privacy.contactText: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please reach out through the platform's support channels.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.introText: Welcome to Financentury. By accessing or using our platform, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
terms.accountText1: You must provide accurate information when creating an account.
terms.accountText2: You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account credentials.
terms.accountText3: You must not share your account or use another person's account without permission.
terms.accountText4: You must be at least 16 years old to use Financentury.
terms.serviceText: Financentury is a budget management tool that allows you to track income, expenses, and financial goals. The service is provided "as is" without guarantees of uninterrupted availability.
terms.limitsText: To ensure fair usage, the following limits apply:
terms.limitBudgets: Up to 7 budgets per user (including collaborated budgets)
terms.dataText: You retain ownership of all financial data you enter into Financentury. We do not claim any rights over your content. You can export or delete your data at any time.
terms.collaborationText: When you invite collaborators to a budget, they can view and add expenses to that budget. You are responsible for managing who has access to your budgets. Collaborators can be removed at any time.
terms.prohibitedText1: Using the platform for any illegal purpose
terms.prohibitedText2: Attempting to gain unauthorized access to other users' data
terms.prohibitedText3: Interfering with the platform's operation or security
terms.prohibitedText4: Using automated tools to scrape or overload the service
terms.terminationText: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms. You may delete your account at any time from your account settings, which will permanently remove all your data.
terms.liabilityText: Financentury is a budgeting tool, not a financial advisor. We are not responsible for financial decisions made based on data in the platform. The service is provided without warranty of any kind.
terms.changesText: We may update these Terms of Service from time to time. Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
terms.contactText: If you have questions about these Terms of Service, please reach out through the platform's support channels.
